Major international sales followed before the family relinquished control.

long_biography.plain_text:
International deal-making was Corrado Agusta's defining contribution to the helicopter group that bore his family name. He built relationships with leading American manufacturers and negotiated some of Agusta's largest export contracts, helping the Italian company progress from licensed production towards aircraft of its own design.

Agusta also led MV Agusta's motorcycle business. He accompanied world champion Giacomo Agostini to Italy's presidential palace in 1971 and commissioned engineer Giuseppe Bocchi to develop an ambitious 500cc boxer racing engine. The unfulfilled project left two prototype engines among the racing assets that EFIM sold in 1986.
